# skycloak_domain_route (Resource)

Maps a realm onto a custom domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "skycloak_domain_route" "app" {
  cluster_id           = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  domain_id            = skycloak_domain.app.id
  realm                = skycloak_realm.app.name
  hide_realm_path      = true
  cors_allowed_origins = ["https://app.example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID. Immutable.
- `domain_id` (String) Custom domain ID. Immutable.
- `realm` (String) Realm to route. Immutable.

### Optional

- `allow_admin_access` (Boolean) Allow admin console access through this route. Defaults to `false`.
- `cors_allowed_origins` (List of String) CORS allowed origins for this route.
- `hide_realm_path` (Boolean) Serve the realm at the domain root (hide `/realms/<name>`). Set at creation; immutable.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Route ID (UUID).
- `updated_at` (String)
